body:
User asked (verbatim):
  ok now we need a flow which works wihtout allow all sites

  lets fix the borken or irititaitng flow

Context:
  Conversation thread: WorkOS chain (staging-app -> api.workos.com -> auth.franchiseatlas.ai -> independent-tea-80-staging.authkit.app) leaked the browser's admin login into persona s2 until every host was allowed one by one; the user only got through by allowing the last host on Library -> Sites, then forget + re-add ('ok great i tworked but no user will ever know this lol / we need to smooth the whole flow'). Allow on all sites shipped as tsk_01a120f63d887cf4b0b8dd8eca59fe3c. Proposed flow explained to the user: a persona tab about to navigate to an unallowed host is stopped before any cookie is sent; a Tabsona page says which site it signs in through with [Allow and continue] / [Open in a normal tab]; one click resumes; the chain is remembered per site; a leaked login is never saved silently (Start over signed out).

Acceptance:
  Without all-sites, adding a site whose sign-in goes through other hosts never leaks the browser's login into the persona; the user is asked per host before the hop, one click continues, and they land on the sign-in form; covered by e2e with a multi-host chain.
title: Smooth sign-in flow without all-sites: stop-and-ask before an unallowed hop
